CustomField.description: The operating entity that actually signs, where a counterparty contracts through subsidiaries or regions. The relationship, and record access, still hang off Counterparty_Account__c: a sharing set matches a Contact to one Account and does not walk an account hierarchy, so modelling subsidiaries as child Accounts would have hidden their contracts from the very people who signed them.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Signing entity, where the counterparty contracts through subsidiaries. Leave empty when the parent signs directly.
CustomField.label: Counterparty Entity
